title: BATTERY POWERED TYCO BATMOBILE...
reason: Appears to be the 2005 Tyco 1:6 Batman Begins Tumbler, a collectable Batman toy, but likely car only, grubby and untested; modest value.
findings: One photo: black moulded model of the Dark Knight 'Tumbler' Batmobile with gold-coloured (bronze finish) suspension arms, nose cap and small round fittings, large rear tyres with silver rims and smaller front wheels. The styling matches the 2005 Tyco/Mattel 1:6 scale R/C 'Batman Begins' Tumbler, but no Tyco, Mattel or DC marking and no model number is legible in the photo (zoomed nose, rear and top). No remote control, battery pack or charger is shown, so it may be the car only. The catalogue claims battery powered, no batteries, 68 cm long; the size cannot be checked from the photo. Price evidence: tycocollectors.com lists the Tyco 2005 Batmobile Tumbler 1/6 at an average of US$85 over 12 recorded sales, highest US$400 (https://tycocollectors.com/product/2005-tyco-batmobile-tumbler-1-6/, viewed 19/10/2026), so a complete one has real value; a car-only example like this should be worth less.
condition: Dusty and grimy, edge wear and paint rubs, gold-coloured trim scuffed; no battery pack or remote shown; some small fittings may be missing; untested.
rescore_note: Looks like the 2005 Tyco 1:6 Batman Begins Tumbler, a genuine collectable (per findings, tycocollectors.com shows an average of US$85 over 12 sales, https://tycocollectors.com/product/2005-tyco-batmobile-tumbler-1-6/, viewed 19/10/2026), but this one is probably car only, grimy, scuffed, untested and unmarked in the photo, so worth less than a complete set.
